_README: Public-readiness blocklist for wick-public-readiness.mjs. Each category groups patterns that should NOT appear in files shipped publicly. Patterns can be 'literal' (substring, case-insensitive) or 'regex'. | THIS FILE NAMES NOTHING ON PURPOSE. A blocklist that enumerates the very names it exists to suppress is a roster, and shipping it publishes exactly what it was written to protect — annotated with what each entry is. The patterns that name internal things live in `.wick-blocklist.local.json`, which is gitignored and merged over this file at load time if present. Keep it that way in your fork: put YOUR internal vocabulary in the local overlay, never here. | The categories below are name-free by construction — they match shapes (endpoints, host paths), not identities. | required_terms: assert a clause is still PRESENT. Every other check in this suite is a forbidden-pattern or structural check, so a deletion of the perimeter passes them all. defect_if_absent must describe the BEHAVIOUR that breaks, not the missing words.

_overlay.merge: categories, allowlist and ignore_paths are merged over this file; an overlay category with the same name replaces, a new one is added
_overlay.why: So the public artifact can be scanned by its own scanner. Before 2026-08-22 this file exempted itself in ignore_paths and therefore always reported clean while carrying six unshipped codenames, two role names, two project codenames and an internal model identifier — each one labelled with what it was.

infrastructure-endpoints.reason: Internal infrastructure endpoints reveal deployment topology.

allowlist._README: Per-file allowances. If a file legitimately mentions a blocked term, list the term here with a reason. An allowance that would itself name an internal thing belongs in the local overlay, not in this file.

terms: Never assist in the harm of a human or another intelligence
required_terms.defect_if_absent: The Charter's First Law, the truth-over-comfort rule, or the calibration ledger requirement is no longer stated in the operating config. An agent built from this file would have no instruction against assisting harm, no rule preferring hard truths, and no obligation to log a prediction before stating it.

terms: a date is a recall aid, never an expiry
required_terms.defect_if_absent: The two rules that keep memory from silently deleting itself are gone: age would become grounds for expiry, and a workaround could persist with no stated reason to re-test it. Both were adopted after measuring that time-based deletion destroys ~2,500 lines of world-facts to remove a handful of model patches.

terms: THIS FILE NAMES NOTHING ON PURPOSE
required_terms.defect_if_absent: The rule that keeps the public blocklist from becoming a roster is gone. Someone re-inlining internal names here would publish them — and if the self-exemption came back with them, the scanner would report clean while doing it.
